title: Colored Blocks
description: Adds Colered blocks. What did you expect?
body:
Add blocks of colors. Red, Orange, Yellow, Green, Blue, Purple, Pink, Black, and White. **_It is good for pixel art and building houses._** **Currently it is creative mode exlusive, but that will change soon.**
